newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: IBCA upgrades Concor long-term rating.
newsitem.headline: IBCA upgrades Concor long-term rating.

text.p: International rating agency IBCA on Monday changed to BBB the long-term domestic rating of Concor Ltd from BBB-.
Concor's short-term A3 domestic rating was reaffirmed.

IBCA said Concor's earnings profile had strengthened during the past three years and that the consistent generation of net interest income coupled with the high net cash balances typically present on the balance sheet reflected the healthy financial profile of the group.
IBCA said that with most areas of activity performing well, the group was well positioned to maintain a sound growth trend.
